tip.title: TIP
tip.command_aura: The command tank boosts every tank in the 8 surrounding cells: the ones with embers rising from the ground are getting the bonus.
tip.armor: Armored enemies subtract their ARMOR from every hit. A tank's PEN ignores it, and poison and fire always burn straight through.
tip.elite: A golden elite! It takes far more punishment than its kin, but drops CRYSTALS when it falls.
tip.no_antiair: WARNING! This level brings FLYERS and you have no anti-air tank. Unlock the MACHINE GUN in the upgrade tree.
tip.radar: The RADAR lights up hidden enemies in its radius: they become targetable again and take +10% damage while marked.
tip.synergy: Zone synergy! Napalm on ice raises steam that softens enemies; fire on a toxic pool makes it explode.
tip.boss_phase: Below half health the boss breaks loose: it speeds up and shuts down a nearby tank for a few seconds.
tip.path_open: Some maps have a sealed route that collapses midway through. Leave room to cover both paths.
tip.ability_ammo: Abilities have limited ammo. Once it runs out you can buy another charge with gold using the same button.
tip.challenges: Every level has three optional challenges: sell nothing, use no abilities, and win with few tanks. Completing them pays extra crystals.
tip.perfect_wave: Clearing a wave without a single leak pays bonus gold, and it grows with the wave number.

manual.title: Manual
results.why_wave: You fell on wave %d  ·  %d enemies got through
advice.air: Flyers skip the path: you need tanks that shoot air (machine gun, sniper, tesla or laser).
advice.armor: That armor eats every hit: raise PEN, or use poison and fire, which ignore it.
advice.healer: The healer heals its allies. Set targeting to First, or place a sniper that reaches it before the rest.
advice.sapper: The sapper shuts down tanks as it passes. Split your defense across two points so you're never blind.
advice.carrier: The carrier drops troops where it falls. Put anti-air early on the path, not next to your fortress.
advice.fewtanks: You arrived with very few tanks. Try upgrading the ones you have (cheaper than a new one) and calling waves early for gold.
advice.generic: Try massing tanks on the corners, where enemies stay in range longest, and fusing two tanks into a better one.
lore.meadow: Green meadows where the invasion began. The wind still smells of cut grass... and gunpowder.
lore.desert: The sands bury the careless. Desert clans wrap their heads against the sun and the shrapnel.
lore.forest: The forest does not forgive. Its creatures wear antlers as trophies and moss as armor.
lore.snow: Here the cold kills before the fangs do. What marches through the blizzard feels nothing anymore.
lore.volcano: The earth bleeds fire. Those who cross the lava return with burning cracks in their hide.
lore.swamp: The swamp swallows every road. Mushrooms nobody should touch sprout from their backs.
lore.crystal: Caverns that sing as you pass. The crystals grow INSIDE those who sleep too close.
lore.ruins: Ruins of an empire that toyed with arcane forces. Their golden masks are still watching.
lore.storm: A sky that never goes quiet. Its beasts draw the lightning... and give it back.
lore.corrupt: The heart of the invasion. Everything that walks here bears the Corruptor's mark.
tree.sum_inherit: Fusions inherit half of both parent tanks' upgrades
results.milestone: Milestone! Wave %d reached for the first time: +%d crystals
tip.portals: This map has PORTALS: the violet ring swallows enemies and the green one spits them out further along. Cover the exit.
tip.boss_slam: The boss STOPS to charge a slam before releasing it: while charging it does not advance, so that is your best window to punish it.
tip.airdrop: Tanks arrive by helicopter and come down on a parachute: they take a second to land and hold fire until they do. Place them early.
tip.bar_tabs: The bar has two tabs: TANKS for the basics and FUSIONS for the recipes you have unlocked.
tip.endless_boons: Every 10 endless waves you pick a REINFORCEMENT that stays for the rest of the run. Some are deals: the enemy gets better, but you pay less or earn more.
boon.title: Reinforcements

skin.victor_locked: Defeat The Corruptor to earn it
synergy.storm: Rain soaks enemies: Tesla and Prism arcs jump 50% farther.
synergy.volcano: The heat feeds the flames: napalm lasts 50% longer on the ground.
mech.sandstorm: Periodic sandstorms: tanks lose range for a few seconds.
mech.bushes: Bushes on the path: enemies inside cannot be targeted.
mech.ice: Ice plates: tanks placed on them fire slower.
mech.lava: Lava cracks that shift between waves: they block building.
mech.fog: Fog over part of the map: reduces tank range inside.
mech.crystals: Amplifying crystals: adjacent tanks deal more damage.
mech.portals: Portals: enemies skip a stretch of the path.
mech.wind: Wind gusts: slow projectiles drift off course.
mech.combo: Combines two mechanics from earlier biomes (varies per level).
trait.icearmor: Ice armor: absorbs the first heavy hits.
trait.igneous: Igneous: immune to fire and drop extra gold.
trait.split: They split into two lesser enemies on death.
trait.shield: Magic shield that regenerates if they take no damage.
trait.evasion: Flyers dodge one shot every few seconds.
trait.elite: Elites with an aura that speeds up nearby enemies.
bossability.enrage: Rage: speeds up when low on health.
bossability.sandveil: Sand veil: periodically hides from tanks.
bossability.regrowth: Regrowth: regenerates if left undamaged for a few seconds.
bossability.frostaura: Frost aura: nearby tanks fire slower.
bossability.deathburst: Final burst: releases fast minions on death.
bossability.summon: Summon: calls minions at half health.
bossability.blink: Blink: teleports down the path as it loses health.
bossability.flight: Flight: crosses the map through the air. Ready your anti-air!
bossability.kingaura: Royal aura: empowers all nearby enemies.
special.charge: Winds up every few seconds and charges at full speed.
special.veil: Fades out at intervals: while it lasts, no tank can target it.
special.wardaura: Wraps nearby allies in a shield of sap.
special.chillaura: Its cold numbs nearby tanks, which fire slower.
special.meltdown: Explodes on death and shuts down adjacent tanks for a few seconds.
special.cloak: Hides the allies around it; it can be targeted itself.
special.guardaura: Lends armour to every nearby ally.
special.warp: Warps a stretch of path ahead, dragging along whoever is next to it.
special.thunder: Flies and strikes a tank from afar, leaving it disabled.
special.frenzy: Below half health it goes berserk and takes less damage.
card.healer_hint: Heals its allies: kill it FIRST or the wave will never drop.
card.sapper_hint: Shuts down tanks as it passes: don't stack everything in one spot.
card.carrier_hint: Drops two runners where it falls: shoot it down far from your fortress.
